name: lz4
description: Extremely fast compression algorithm with high speed compression and decompression

tools.description: Ultra-fast compression tool optimized for speed over compression ratio
tools.usage:
lz4 file.txt # Compress file to file.txt.lz4
lz4 -d file.txt.lz4 # Decompress to original
lz4 -9 file.txt # Maximum compression level
lz4 -c file.txt | process # Compress to stdout for piping
lz4 -f existing.lz4 # Force overwrite existing compressed file
